Point-in-time rule: each weekly fit uses only games strictly before its anchor; a game’s rating enters kickoff and never sees its own result
Missing values: NaN until 200 settled training games and for teams with no prior history; in-model median imputation

net_rating_diff.tooltip:
What: Home minus away fitted net team rating
Definition: net_rating_home - net_rating_away, where net_rating_T is the two-channel scoring+win net (equal to off_rating_T + def_rating_T) blended 55/45 with a calibrated pre-kickoff Elo prior.  The Elo prior is consumed at build time and is NOT served; the raw elo_* columns remain retired, and the net is not equal to off_rating_diff + def_rating_diff
Source: decided NFL game scores (nflverse schedules)
Window: expanding settled history; 240-day scoring half-life, 180-day win-channel half-life, last pre-kickoff Elo; refit at every observed game date · Built as: fixed-weight blend (0.41 scoring net, 0.14 win ridge, 0.45 Elo) of the per-anchor z-scores across the 32 team identities, rescaled to the scoring net’s points centre and spread
Point-in-time rule: each weekly fit uses only games strictly before its anchor; the Elo entering the game is the frame’s point-in-time value
Missing values: complete: before 200 settled training games the net is ELO_BLEND * the calibrated Elo prior (a zero fitted net); no NaN warmup
Available to: [’linear’, ’tree’, ’mlp’]
